title: Choose a capture’s media type
responsibility: Chooses an allowed media type from the capture kind, recorded type and byte signatures.

inputs.name: artifactMedia.capture
inputs.description: The capture kind and recorded media type. Supported kinds are screenshot, audio, output, assertions and trace.

inputs.name: artifactMedia.bytes
inputs.description: The bytes to inspect. Screenshots need a PNG or JPEG signature. Audio needs a supported recorded type and matching signature. Text results must be valid UTF-8 without a null character.

outputs.name: artifactLimit
outputs.description: The shared maximum artifact size, 11 MiB or 11,534,336 bytes. This function exports the limit; media-type selection does not itself enforce it.

outputs.name: artifactMedia
outputs.description: PNG or JPEG for screenshots; WAV, MPEG, MP4 or Ogg for supported audio. Results use application/json only when recorded as JSON and successfully parsed; otherwise they use UTF-8 plain text. No HTML type is returned.

errors.name: type-not-attested
errors.description: Throws when the capture kind is unsupported, screenshot or audio signatures do not match an accepted format, the recorded audio type is unsupported, or a result is not valid text. Invalid JSON falls back to plain text.
